common.forbidden: Your account isn’t an administrator on this server.
common.unsupported: This server doesn’t offer this feature.
common.invalid: Fix the highlighted values before saving.

restart.title: Restart Required
restart.desc: Some changes take effect only after the server restarts.
restart.confirmText: Playback in progress will stop and the server will be unavailable for a moment.

server.networkFoot: Network settings take effect when the server restarts.
server.portClash: Local HTTP and HTTPS ports must be different.
server.networkUnavailable: This server’s network configuration couldn’t be read.
server.riskyText: These changes affect how the server is reached. You could lose access from Wicaby or from outside your network:

uiCulture.label: Display Language
uiCulture.desc: Language of the server’s notifications and dashboard.

metadataLanguage.label: Metadata Language
metadataLanguage.desc: Preferred language for titles, overviews and images.

metadataCountry.label: Country
metadataCountry.desc: Used for age ratings and release dates.

logRetention.label: Log Retention
logRetention.desc: Days before old logs are deleted.

httpPort.label: Local HTTP Port
httpPort.desc: The port the server listens on in your local network.

httpsPort.label: Local HTTPS Port
httpsPort.desc: Port for encrypted connections in your local network.

remoteAccess.label: Remote Access
remoteAccess.desc: Allows connections from outside your local network.

publicHttpPort.label: Public HTTP Port
publicHttpPort.desc: Port exposed to the internet, if different from the local one.

publicHttpsPort.label: Public HTTPS Port
publicHttpsPort.desc: HTTPS port exposed to the internet.

domain.label: External Domain
domain.desc: Domain name used to reach the server from the internet.

upnp.label: Automatic Port Mapping (UPnP)
upnp.desc: Opens ports on your router when it allows it.

lan.label: Local Networks
lan.desc: Addresses or subnets treated as local, one per line. Leave empty to detect them automatically.
lan.invalid: An entry isn’t a valid address or subnet.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.desc: URL prefix when the server sits behind a reverse proxy.

proxies.label: Known Proxies
proxies.desc: Addresses of trusted reverse proxies, one per line.

hwaccel.label: Acceleration Type
hwaccel.desc: Uses the graphics card to decode and encode video.

qsvDevice.label: Quick Sync Device
qsvDevice.desc: Leave empty to pick one automatically.

hwEncoding.label: Hardware Encoding
hwEncoding.desc: Also encodes video on the graphics card.

hevc10.label: Decode 10-Bit HEVC
hevc10.desc: Turn on if the graphics card supports it.

vp910.label: Decode 10-Bit VP9
vp910.desc: Turn on if the graphics card supports it.

preset.label: Encoder Preset
preset.desc: Slower gives better quality at the same bitrate.

h264Crf.label: H.264 Quality (CRF)
h264Crf.desc: From 0 to 51, lower for better quality. Default 23.

h265Crf.label: H.265 Quality (CRF)
h265Crf.desc: From 0 to 51, lower for better quality. Default 28.

maxTranscodes.label: Simultaneous Transcodes
maxTranscodes.desc: Maximum number of video transcodes at once, 0 for no limit.

tonemap.label: Tone Mapping
tonemap.desc: Converts HDR to SDR for screens that can’t show it.

tonemapMode.label: Mode
tonemapMode.desc: Channels the tone mapping applies to.

throttling.label: Throttle Transcoding
throttling.desc: Slows encoding down once the client is far enough ahead.

throttleDelay.label: Throttle Delay
throttleDelay.desc: Seconds of lead before throttling starts.

segmentDeletion.label: Delete Segments
segmentDeletion.desc: Removes segments already played to save disk space.

segmentKeep.label: Keep Segments For
segmentKeep.desc: Seconds before a played segment is deleted.

downmixBoost.label: Stereo Downmix Boost
downmixBoost.desc: Gain applied when multichannel audio is mixed down to stereo.

tempPath.label: Temporary Folder
tempPath.desc: Where the server writes transcoding files.

transcoding.noHwCodecs: No hardware codecs were detected on this server.
transcoding.showOther: {n, plural, one {Show # More Setting} other {Show # More Settings}}

plugins.configureHint: Opens the plugin’s page on the server in your browser.
plugins.uninstallText: The plugin is removed the next time the server restarts. Its settings may be lost.
plugins.installedFoot: Installs, updates and removals take effect when the server restarts.
plugins.catalogEmpty: The catalog is empty or can’t be reached.
plugins.confirmInstallText: A plugin runs on the server with full access. It loads the next time the server restarts.

repos.foot: The catalog lists the plugins of every repository that’s on.
repos.addText: Only add repositories you trust: a plugin has access to the whole server.
repos.name: Name
repos.removeText: Its plugins leave the catalogue. Plugins already installed stay in place.

apikeys.intro: API keys give outside apps full administrator access. Don’t share them.
apikeys.foot: An app whose key is revoked loses access right away.
apikeys.newText: Name the app that will use this key.
apikeys.revealText: Copy the key for {app} now: it won’t be shown in full again.
apikeys.revokeText: The app using it will no longer reach the server. This can’t be undone.

logs.filteredCount: {n, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} of {total}
logs.foot: Logs can contain paths and addresses: check them before sharing.
